---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or behavior change
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What is missing or awkward today? Use cases, not solutions.

## Proposed behavior

What the feature should do, in one sentence. Then as much detail as useful.

## Impact checklist (quick)

- [ ] Reads/writes storage → a new `wird-*` key (schema + DOCUMENTATION §4)
- [ ] Makes a network request (new domain? update NETWORK.md + privacy.ts)
- [ ] Touches privacy/security guarantees
- [ ] New user-facing string (AR + EN parity)
- [ ] Accessibility / reduced-motion impact
- [ ] Needs a migration or deprecation (VERSIONING.md)

## Notes

Anything that helps a maintainer scope it (mockups, related issues,
privacy constraints that apply).
